caseName: Toole v. Michigan State Board of Dentistry
caseNameFull: Toole v. Michigan State Board of Dentistry
attorneys: Mr. Edward N. Barnard for appellants. Messrs. Herbert J. Rushton, Attorney General of Michigan, and Wilbur M. Brucker, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Michigan.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question. Semler v. Dental Examiners, 294 U. S. 608, and cases cited.
